title: Verificación: MLX DeepSeek V4 Flash Q2 up to 256K context works but 'loops in thinking' - not prime time yet
summary: Claim revisado: MLX enables impressive long-context (256K) with low KV memory on high-end Apple Silicon. Evidencia: Full benchmark table for Q2KExperts-Q8Rest-mlx on M3 Ultra 512GB: speeds, mem (158.5GB at 256K), KV (1.76GB), batch TPS, perplexity ~1.16. Author notes 'Not yet ready for the prime time, because it loops in thinking here and there, I'm investigating. Next test is distributed!'. Caveat editorial: Author's own caveat on stability (thinking loops); impressive numbers but requires custom branch and high-RAM hardware. Not plug-and-play for production.. Reproducibilidad: high - exhaustive table, exact model/quant recipe, command example, hardware, known issues stated by author.
